methodology_other: Change detection on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images acquired before and after the event. Damage Proxy Maps show significant changes in radar coherence and amplitude; Flood Proxy Maps show areas that changed to standing water. Maps are preliminary and checked against news reports and ground-level imagery where available.

# Mozambique Cyclone Jude: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Mar 2025

The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Mozambique Cyclone Jude (Mar 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it.

## Maps in this dataset

- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Nampula Province, Mozambique, Tropical Cyclone Jude, 13 Mar 2025, v0.8**
- **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Zambeziar Province, Mozambique, Tropical Cyclone Jude, 13 Mar 2025, v0.7**

**More map details and files:** <https://sf.earthobservatory.sg/event/EOS-RS_202503_Mozambique_Cyclone_Jude>

organization.description: The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) is a research lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. It uses satellite remote sensing, mainly synthetic aperture radar (SAR), to map natural hazards and disasters. The lab produces Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) and Flood Proxy Maps (FPMs) showing where damage or flooding has likely occurred. Its work focuses on Southeast Asia and the wider Asia-Pacific, and it also responds to major disasters worldwide.

EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Nampula Province, Mozambique, Tropical Cyclone Jude, 13 Mar 2025, v0.8

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Damage Proxy Map (DPM) depicting areas that are likely damaged in the Nampula Province, Mozambique, due to Tropical Cyclone Jude. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (01 Nov 2024 to 17 Feb 2025) and after (13 Mar 2025) the event.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Flood Proxy Map (FPM) depicting areas that are likely flooded in the Zambeziar Province, Mozambique, due to Tropical Cyclone Jude. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (05 May 2024 to 19 Dec 2024) and after (13 Mar 2025) the event.
